name: tranyx-functions
description: Tranyx Cloud Functions (server-side on-chain credit; withdrawals follow in feat/fn-solana-payout)

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && rm -f .env.local && ENFORCE_APP_CHECK=true CREDIT_MOCK_SOLANA=1 firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.functions-test.json --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-tranyx "vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts" && echo ENFORCE_APP_CHECK=false > .env.local && ENFORCE_APP_CHECK=false CREDIT_MOCK_SOLANA=1 firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.functions-test.json --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-tranyx "vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts"; rc=$?; rm -f .env.local; exit $rc
